decisionBox.changed: Position moves from midnight's ADD to REDUCE, and the tilt flips from bullish to bearish, because midnight's own add thesis failed to confirm on every axis it named. Midnight bought 20 USDT of spot at 78,947.2 on the strength of endday's fired add gate and a 1H MACD histogram that had just crossed positive. Four things have gone the other way since. The 1H histogram crossed back NEGATIVE - the sequence reads -3.24, +0.91, +2.51, -9.66, -33.36, -28.17, so the positive cross lasted exactly two bars. Price failed 132.7 points short of midnight's 79,244.8 add ceiling and has not closed above the 1H EMA20 since. The 78,308.8 floor that held eight straight hourly bars has been undercut by 62.3 points. And the 15m book has flipped wholesale: spot is now below the EMA20, EMA50, EMA100 AND EMA200, where midnight found it coiled in the middle of all four. Set against that, midnight's REDUCE gate did NOT fire - the 09:00Z bar closed 78,448.0, a settled close 187.7 below the 78,635.7 line, and the 10:00Z bar reclaimed it at 78,726.5 on the FIRST permitted bar. The two-bar clause blocked it for the fourth time in two days. That is why this is a 12 percent trim and not an exit: the gate machinery says the break is not confirmed, while the momentum says the add was early. Trimming the tranche that is not working is the honest answer to both.

calibration.rollingRecord: Grading midnight against this 07:05 COT read of 78,484.4. NEITHER of midnight's gates fired. The reduce gate required a settled 1H close below 78,635.7 with no reclaim on either of the next two bars: the 09:00Z bar closed 78,448.0, a settled close 187.7 points below the line, and the 10:00Z bar closed 78,726.5 and reclaimed it on the FIRST permitted bar. That is the fourth false trigger the two-bar clause has filtered in two days. The add gate at a settled close above 79,244.8 was never reached; the highest close since publication is 78,925.9, short by 318.9 points. Midnight's 77,854.1 invalidation was not revisited - the lowest print since is 78,246.5, some 392.4 points above it. Midnight deployed 20.00 USDT into the spot core at 78,947.2 and spot is 78,484.4, so that tranche is down 0.59 percent, roughly 0.12 USDT. acting_helped is FALSE. That makes it two consecutive sessions where the desk acted on a fired gate and the gate was right about direction for less than four hours. The instructive detail is that midnight bought a MACD histogram cross that had printed exactly two positive bars - +0.91 and +2.51 - after six negative ones. Two bars is not a cross, it is a pause. The transferable rule: a histogram cross earns a trade only after it holds through a third bar, and midnight had the discipline to size at 20 of 85 rather than the whole book, which is the only reason this costs 0.12 USDT instead of 0.5.
calibration.note: Eight-session rolling record: one directional call in five has paid. The machinery is outperforming the direction - the two-bar reclaim clause has now blocked four bad exits, and small position sizing has kept every losing call under 0.15 USDT.
